name: partner-family-routing
instructions: Classify the PRIMARY commercial relationship described by the supplied evidence, not the general occupation of the organization. Select insufficient_evidence if economics, audience control or responsibility is unclear. Do not invent terms or authorization. This is an advisory classification, never approval to act.

options.F1: Affiliates are independent publishers, creators, list owners or businesses who promote an offer to their audience and are paid only on a tracked outcome (sale, lead, call, install or signup), attributed by link, code or platform.
options.F2: Influencers & Creators are individuals paid at least partly in cash, product, retainer or equity for their content, endorsement or creative voice.
options.F3: A sponsorship is a paid placement (cash or in-kind) inside media, a property or an event that someone else owns and controls.
options.F4: Co-Promotion is two or more businesses jointly promoting an event, offer or content piece to their combined audiences.
options.F5: Stages & Media is earned or arranged exposure where you appear as a guest, speaker, expert or source on a platform someone else owns.
options.F6: Referral & Power Partners are businesses and professionals who already serve your buyers and send you specific named introductions, or endorse your offer to their customers.
options.F7: Access Partners are organizations that own a group your buyers already belong to: members, franchisees, employees, community members or attendees.
options.F8: Channel Partners are third parties who resell, deliver, embed or distribute your offer.
options.F9: Strategic Alliances & Licensing are long-term contractual or equity arrangements that share intellectual property, brand, method, territory, ownership or operations, beyond any single campaign or sale.
options.F10: Cause & Nonprofit Partners are charities, schools, teams, faith and civic groups where the business's contribution (a percentage of sales, a donation per unit, a fundraiser share or in-kind support) produces revenue, traffic or community access in return.
options.F11: House Partners are the business's own base: customers, past buyers, old leads, employees, contractors and alumni.
options.insufficient_evidence: The relationship is unclear or not covered by evidence

state.relationship: An independent newsletter promotes an offer and is paid only on tracked sales.
A podcast sells a paid mid-roll advertising placement, regardless of sales.
We want to work with a creator; payment and responsibility are unknown.
